01
Temporal analysis

Ranked popularity streams

Area bump chart for the top 20 names by sex. Each decade, names are stacked by rank (most births at the top); band width encodes births and streams cross as rankings shift.

02
Spatial analysis

Department map & regional compass

Choropleth by department paired with a macro-region compass. Map color and ray length both encode rate / 10k (share per 10,000 births in the department or macro-region), not absolute birth counts.

03
Gender analysis

Gender ratio trajectories

Twenty-five trajectories from a 5×5 grid (female-ratio bands × top names at a reference decade). Tracks how the gender mix of popular names evolves over time.
